Dyersville Media Channel

City of Dyersville Media Channel is a local access channel that airs government and non-for-profit programs in and around the Dyersville area. Dyersville Media Channel broadcasts on Mediacom Channel 8, on the City's website, on Apple TV device, and on Rukus device. For more information, please contact the City of Dyersville by email at info@cityofdyersville.com or by phone at (563) 875-7724.
